en.headline: MTR resumes Kwun Tong Line after platform equipment smoke at Lam Tin
en.dek: Smoke from platform equipment at Lam Tin station this morning caused trains to skip the stop and the station to close temporarily; services have since returned to normal.
body: The MTR Corporation said equipment on the platform at Lam Tin station emitted smoke at about 8:56am on Wednesday, prompting trains on the Kwun Tong Line to skip the station while staff and firefighters investigated.

According to reports, the station exits were closed and free shuttle buses ran between Kwun Tong and Yau Tong, with passengers able to alight or board at Lam Tin. Firefighters extinguished the source in a platform equipment room by about 9:23am; no one was injured and roughly 2,000 passengers were affected.

The MTR said the situation was resolved by about 9:58am and Kwun Tong Line services were returning to normal. The incident followed a separate trackside fire at the same station on Tuesday evening that had also disrupted services for a period.

zh.headline: 藍田站月台設備冒煙已處理 觀塘綫服務逐步復常
zh.dek: 周三早上藍田站月台有設備冒煙，觀塘綫列車一度不停該站，車站暫時關閉；港鐵指情況已處理好，服務陸續恢復正常。
body: 港鐵公司表示，周三早上約8時56分，藍田站月台有設備冒煙，為確保安全，觀塘綫列車一度不停藍田站。
現場消息指，車站出口落閘，消防到場處理，約9時23分將火種救熄；事件中無人受傷，約2000名乘客受影響。港鐵安排免費接駁巴士來往觀塘至油塘站，藍田站乘客可中途上下車。
港鐵其後表示情況已處理好，觀塘綫列車服務於早上約9時58分起逐步恢復正常。事隔不足15小時，藍田站再度出現事故；周二傍晚該站路軌旁亦曾發生火警，一度影響觀塘至調景嶺服務。
